ORAL ORDER
The petition is preferred calling in question the registration of a crime in Crime No.94/2022 for offences punishable under Sections 403, 408 and 420 of the IPC.
2. There is no representation on behalf of the petitioner.
3. Learned Addl.SPP on instructions and verification of the records would submit that the police after investigation have filed a charge sheet against the petitioner in C.C.No.18700/2022.
4. In that light, the petition is disposed reserving liberty to the petitioner to challenge the charge sheet, if he so desires.
5. The contentions that are urged in the subject petition are also reserved to be urged in the challenge to the charge sheet, if any.
NC: 2026:KHC:374 HC-KAR Ordered accordingly.
